tlc59208f_id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID of the [TLC59208F chip](https://esphome.io/components/output/tlc59208f#tlc59208f-component). Use this if you have multiple TLC59208Fs you want to use at the same time.
